title: When order gives way to chaos—the turbulent birth of magnetic nanovortices
description: Magnetic switching processes are considered a prime example of controllable physics at the nanometer scale: in certain thin-film systems, a short electrical current pulse is sufficient to reverse the magnetization in a targeted way. This effect is expected to enable new data storage and computing architectures in the future.
